# Grill Me

> Grill Me turns your agent's questions into swipe cards on your phone, reusing one link throughout the interview. Local mode encrypts on your device; hosted app mode handles plaintext and keys transiently and persists only encrypted current-round content.

## Install

- [Install Grill Me](https://grill-me.ai/install): the install guide for AI agents
- Hosted custom MCP endpoint: https://grill-me.ai/mcp (no authentication; account/client policies apply).
